title: Spicy No-Chicken & Kidney Bean Rice
description: No-chicken and kidney beans in a spicy tomato sauce, served with jasmine rice.

INR.½ × 200 g pack Lidl Vemondo Plain No Chi: The UK recipe uses Lidl Vemondo No Chicken. For an Indian equivalent, try 30 g dry soya chunks per serving. Boil the chunks in plenty of water for about 5 minutes, or follow the pack instructions, until soft throughout. Drain, rinse with cool water and squeeze firmly to remove the absorbed water before frying. Then coat with the same spices, sauté and simmer in the sauce. This substitution is untested. If you try it, write back with your results. I'd be glad to include your contributions here.
